flavor.description: Equipment: Plate armor, greatsword, glaive, longbow, handaxes.

additionalAbilities.name: Superior Critical
additionalAbilities.description: Tomkin's weapon attacks score a critical hit on a natural 18–20.

additionalAbilities.name: Remarkable Athlete
additionalAbilities.description: Tomkin has advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks. After a critical hit, he can move up to half his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

additionalAbilities.name: Action Surge (1/Short Rest)
additionalAbilities.description: On his turn, Tomkin can take one additional action, except the Magic action.

additionalAbilities.name: Indomitable (2/Long Rest)
additionalAbilities.description: After failing a saving throw, Tomkin can reroll it with a +15 bonus and must use the new result.

additionalAbilities.name: Second Wind (4 Uses)
additionalAbilities.description:
Bonus Action. Tomkin regains 1d10 + 15 HP. He regains one use after a Short Rest and all uses after a Long Rest.
